name: Meteorstrahl
description: When you use this move, soak in cosmic energy and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, saving throws you cause have their DC increased by 3, and you may use an action to create a {shape} of cosmic energy, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a {save} or take {dice} {type} damage on a fail and half as much on a save.
